basic_info.description: Welcome to 276 Ewing Terrace, Where San Francisco architecture meets modern living.  Charming 3 bedroom, 2 bath home located in the desirable Lone Mountain neighborhood. This beautifully maintained residence features gleaming hardwood floors, a previously updated kitchen with new quartz countertops and backsplash, a commercial Challenger Wolf range that is not only functional but exudes timeless charm.  The upper level boasts a bright living room with coved ceiling, and corner fireplace; formal dining room, a spacious kitchen, a main bedroom with expanded sunroom, a second bright bedroom, and a full bathroom with tub and a hidden shower and storage. The upstairs rooms feature delicate detailed plasterwork design on ceilings in bedrooms and dining room.  The lower level offers a private retreat with a bedroom, bathroom, and second living area with backyard access and a separate entrance through the front entry—perfect for guests, remote work, or additional privacy.  The fenced backyard, nestled against SFU, provides a coveted space for relaxation or gatherings. Additional amenities include forced air heating, a 32 foot deep (potential tandem) garage, full sized washer & dryer, and storage. Near Trader Joes, Laurel Village, Sacramento Street shops, dining, Golden gate park & NOPA.
